oneOf.description: Existing shape: a command argv array, rendered verbatim.
Object step: a command plus an optional platform tag and cargo target. Shape only; the sc-lint binary owns platform, target, and command-shape semantics.

lint_profiles.description: Optional named lint profiles: profile name to ordered list of step names from `profiles`. Shape only; the sc-lint binary rejects unknown, duplicate, empty, and colliding members.
